piezas.titulo: Reading words: Weather, climate and experiences
texto: Reading and spelling of weather terms and descriptive adjectives: «ฝนตก» has «ฝน» (high-class consonant ฝ with the implicit short vowel o and the nasal น, rising tone) and «ตก» (mid-class consonant ต, low tone). «อากาศ» is a classic loanword with the initial consonant อ, the vowel า, the low-class consonant ค and the final consonant ศ (which sounds like [t] in แม่กด, falling tone). «ร้อน» has the low-class consonant ร with the sign ้ (high tone). «สนุก» has ส with the short vowel a and หนุก with the implicit high-class consonant ห นํา น, which brings the tone down to low. Recognising these roots lets you read weather bulletins and tourist reviews.

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «ฤดูฝนในเอเชียตะวันออกเฉียงใต้นำความชุ่มชื้นมาสู่ผืนป่าและพื้นที่เกษตรกรรม» express?

opciones.texto: The monsoon season brings greenery to the forests and farmland.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «ฤดูฝนในเอเชียตะวันออกเฉียงใต้นำความชุ่มชื้นมาสู่ผืนป่าและพื้นที่เกษตรกรรม» from the text.

opciones.texto: The daytime heat makes drinking cool water an ideal way to cool down.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another statement from the passage, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: Travelling to northern Thailand in winter offers a fresh, invigorating climate.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.

pregunta.texto: In the word «อากาศ» (weather / air), how is the final consonant ศ pronounced?

opciones.texto: As a voiceless alveolar stop [t] (แม่กด group)
opciones.explicacion: Correct: the sibilant ศ in final syllable position is pronounced as a [t] stop.
Incorrect: standard Thai does not allow [s] at the end of a syllable.
Incorrect: ศ is a consonant, not a vowel sign.
